about: tools/dialect_check.py's reviewed exceptions (Docs/Design/83-dialogue-trees.md, Phase 4). erased: places nobody lives in any more (lines gated only to them never play). ordinary: a dialect's phrases that are ordinary speech too (a fen worker's 'the eel-traps' is a thing, not an accent; 'fair enough' is everyone's), so the lexicon leaves them out. marked: single words that are a dialect's own (a single word counts only here). lines: a hit allowed where it is, with why (phrase, file, and text it is in). places: names the world has that the database's rooms don't list (its land, roads, waters). legend: names in the regional lore kept as legend, with why. people: names of people in the lore (not places).
ordinary: a bed or a bite neighbour
